labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a new SpeedColumn API; a feature request, not a bug.

body:
Thanks for the detailed proposal. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue can be considered, so please start there.

Rich already supports a version of this: you can subclass `ProgressColumn` in [rich/progress.py](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/progress.py) to render speed in any unit, as `TransferSpeedColumn` does for bytes. Related: #3835 covers speed in `TaskProgressColumn` when `total` is set.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
